body.statement: For the common limit \(G_{\infty}\), the map \(\beta\mapsto q_{\alpha,\beta}\) is continuous, \(0<q_{\alpha,\beta}<\infty\), and \[0<\inf_{\beta\in\mathcal K}f_{\beta}(q_{\alpha,\beta})\le\sup_{\beta\in\mathcal K}f_{\beta}(q_{\alpha,\beta})<\infty.\] The coarea version \(\mathcal C(\beta,u)\) is continuous on a neighborhood of \(\{(\beta,q_{\alpha,\beta}):\beta\in\mathcal K\}\); consequently \(\Gamma(\beta)\) and \(B(\beta)=\operatorname{tr}\{\Gamma(\beta)I_{\mathrm{eff}}(\beta)^{-1}\}\) are continuous on \(\mathcal K\).
body.justification: Uniform coarea control makes the moving Gaussian acceptance boundary differentiable without adding a separate density assumption.
body.gap: Existing rerandomization limits use fixed quadratic forms; the uniform statement over an empirical-oracle chart is an auxiliary bridge to second order.
body.consumer: It supplies the stable quantile derivative needed to translate efficient pilot uncertainty into action regret.
